scope: All five active documents and the two structured source families used by the v0.3 app
finding: The five document records are public government or OCHA publications. Four carry public finances.ml PDF source URLs in Supabase metadata. The OCHA 2026 plan has no source_url in the database but is listed on OCHA's public publications site. HAPI is a public OCHA data API; FONGIM is queried from the public interactive-map Power BI model.
limits: This is a metadata and source-publication classification. It does not certify byte-for-byte identity between stored chunks and public PDFs, nor inspect every FONGIM field for sensitive content.
